title: Dinner Binder
user: Households with digital recipe collections who need a clean, reliable printable cooking packet for a week, trip, or screen-free kitchen.
smallest_useful_product: A static offline web app that accepts Markdown/JSON recipe files, selects recipes and servings, creates a paginated print packet with ingredient checkboxes, consolidated prep timeline, and optional allergen notes.
success_measure: 80% of users can turn three supplied recipes into a correctly paginated, readable print packet in under three minutes.
constraints: Input only user-owned/exported recipes; preserve attribution fields; support printer-safe CSS and accessible typography; no dietary or allergy safety guarantees.
